source_or_basis: No India->Panama LCL quote found. Proxies: Suaid Global 2026 base LCL India->US USD 85-160/CBM, India->Europe 65-140/CBM (https://suaidglobal.com/insights/lcl-shipping-rates/, updated 07/23/2026); Cogoport Sep-2025 Ahmedabad LCL to USA INR 7,000-8,500/CBM, Europe INR 6,200-7,000/CBM (https://www.cogoport.com/blogs/ahmedabad-lcl-shipping-rates-v20251003); CMA CGM FAK ISC->Manzanillo PA USD 3,750/20' (Jun-2026) / ~19-25 CBM usable = USD 150-200/CBM carrier cost before consolidator margin -> thin transshipment lane priced above US/EU lanes.

Crowley tariff Rule 18 (23rd rev., eff. 27-Feb-2020): Panama LCL deconsolidation USD 0.22/CFT (=7.77/CBM) min USD 55/shipment (https://www.crowley.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2023/10/Destination-Handling-Charge-DHC-23rd-Revised.pdf); Suaid: destination CFS USD 15-40/CBM.
Crowley: AMSA fee USD 15/shipment + deconsolidation min USD 55; Suaid: destination handling USD 45-95 + documentation USD 35-75 per shipment (generic, not Panama-specific).
Truck Manzanillo/Colon CFS -> licensed warehouse Panama City (~80 km); no public tariff found.

Statutory MINIMUM (Codigo Fiscal art. 647 as amended by Ley 20/1994 art. 7): CIF<=B/.5,000: B/.30; 5,000.01-10,000: +B/.20; >10,000: B/.50 + B/.0.0015 per balboa CIF; +B/.2 per extra tariff line => ~B/.80-98 for a USD 20k, 10-line entry (https://docs.panama.justia.com/federales/leyes/20-de-1994-aug-16-1994.pdf). New tariff (ANA Res. 353 of 1-Oct-2024) suspended by Res. 904-04-649-OAL of 29-Nov-2024 (https://cdn.corprensa.com/la-prensa/uploads/2024/11/29/RESOLUCION%20TARIFAS%20AGENTES%20ADUANEROS.pdf). Market fee assumed above minimum.
ANA/SIGA per-declaration fees not found in public sources; contingency only.
No public marine-cargo rate found; typical ICC(A) range assumed. Cross-check: PAHO Strategic Fund advises adding 20-25% for freight+insurance to its reference prices.

WITS/UNCTAD TRAINS 2022, Panama on India: HS 300410, 300420, 300490 MFN 0.00% / applied 0.00% (https://wits.worldbank.org/tariff/trains/en/country/PAN/partner/IND/product/300490). ITBMS: medicines exempt (https://dgi.mef.gob.pa/itbms/Generalidades.php).

Project questionnaire: first order 5 mixed pallets 120x100x160 cm, ~10 m3, ~500 kg/pallet, LCL, ~USD 20,000 CIF/FOB, ~925,000 tablets (Cuestionario_operativo_5_tarimas.xlsx). Low=20 CBM consolidation, high=5 CBM.

CMA CGM FAK ISC->Manzanillo, Panama per 20': USD 2,600 from 15-Feb-2026 (https://container-news.com/cma-cgm-updates-fak-rates-from-indian-subcontinent-to-latin-america); USD 3,100 from 15-Mar-2026 (https://airfreight.news/articles/full/cma-cgm-fak-rates-from-the-indian-subcontinent-to-latin-america-as-of-march-15th-2026); USD 3,750 from 10-Jun-2026 (https://www.ajot.com/news/cma-cgm-fak-rates-from-the-indian-subcontinent-to-latin-america-and-north-europe-the-mediterranean-north-africa). Excl. THC origin/destination, PSS, security. High = estimate given Jul-2026 India-LatAm squeeze (JNPT-Santos ~USD 9,000/40', https://maritimegateway.com/india-latin-america-freight-rates).
Panama destination THC/DO for a 20' not found publicly.
10 pallets 1.2x1.0x1.6 m single-stacked in a 20' = ~19 m3 cargo; 25 if lower pallets double-stacked.

Decreto Ejecutivo 27 de 10-May-2024 (G.O. 30028-C) Art. 15 lists no per-shipment import fee for registered non-controlled medicines (B/.50 only for controlled-substance permits). One-time: registro sanitario B/.500/product; Certificacion de Importacion al amparo de RS vigente B/.500; Excepcion de RS para adquisicion publica/privada B/.500; licencia distribuidora B/.200/2 yrs (https://minsa.gob.pa/sites/default/files/general/decreto_ejecutivo_27_de_10_de_mayo_de_2024.pdf). Not included in per-unit landed cost.
